1、本游戏是一款3D角色扮演类回合制游戏，适用于年满<unbreak>12</unbreak>周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。

2、本游戏基于架空背景展开剧情，用户可通过对话、交互、完成任务推进剧情，游戏内还可以自由探索场景地图。游戏中有需要使用游戏角色进行的人机对战，玩法基于一定难度的思考判断，鼓励玩家随机应变、制定策略来取得对战胜利。游戏中有少量自定义文字系统，该社交系统遵循相关法律法规进行管理。

3、本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，认证为未成年的用户将受到以下游戏限制：
未满8周岁的用户不能充值；8周岁以上未满<unbreak>16</unbreak>周岁的未成年用户，单次充值金额不得超过<unbreak>50</unbreak>元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过<unbreak>200</unbreak>元人民币；<unbreak>16</unbreak>周岁以上的未成年用户，单次充值金额不得超过<unbreak>100</unbreak>元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过<unbreak>400</unbreak>元人民币。
游戏仅会在周五、周六、周日和法定节假日的<unbreak>20</unbreak>时至<unbreak>21</unbreak>时，向未成年人提供1小时游戏服务。

4、游戏玩法鼓励玩家积极思考，制定和应用策略来取得对战的胜利。同时，在游戏中呈现了精美细腻的画面效果，能够为玩家提供优质的视觉体验。

6609739095869656839: He thought of that lonely island of Insumousu, bristling with rusted, broken swords. He wanted to go back, just once, to let those sword cries of grief, of hatred, of sorrow, rest in peace, if only for a moment. He thought of his aging master, and the warmth born of longing and shame welled up in his chest. Closing his eyes, he could almost smell the smoke and fire of the Zhuming, hear the endless rhythm of hammers on anvils. "Once this is all over, maybe I could..." He let out a long sigh. Then he turned and walked back to the Hunters' camp. "Mara-struck? He's completely cured... At least he's no longer clamoring to skin that little azure dragon alive." "Oh, right, about that box Blade mentioned, he admitted that the stuff inside was a gift for us!" He gently pushed the door open, frowning: "Do I really need to report matters unrelated to the mission to her as well?" "Bladie, thank you." A woman's voice came through the phone. "No need." "We'll celebrate for you once everyone is back." The man paused, took a few steps, then stopped again. "The item in the iron box is poorly made. If you want, I can make another." "Okay, sure," the young girl looked at him in surprise, "then why don't you tell her yourself? Look, talking to you just made me have to restart again!" He didn't reply, but turned around and headed to the next room. "Practice hard, the next time we PK when your hand is healed, I won't go easy on you." "Okay." He unfastened the Shard Sword and placed it by the bed. In the past, it was resentment, it was fury, it was regret, it was the embodiment of all agony. He stroked the shattered blade.
